name: Site
description: Provides a revisionable, fieldable Site entity that records and shares a Drupal site's health/state.
project_description:
The Site.module allows you to track, store, and send information about your websites.

 When installed in a Drupal site, a Site Entity is created to store site status, properties like PHP and Drupal versions, fields, state, and a human-readable "reasons" output. Site report snapshots provide a historical record of site state. Connect to a Site Manager instance to send out reports to a central dashboard.

 Site entities can represent any website with a URL. Use site module to build a custom Website Management System to track everything in one place.

 
 ▶ Site Module Presentation 

 Try Site Module on SimplyTest.me 

 
 NOTICE: The Site.module needs your support! 
 The Site and Site Manager modules are free open source tools, often worked on by unpaid volunteers.

 Without your ongoing support, regular maintenance cannot be guaranteed.

 Please consider supporting the project financially , or if possible, provide community support such as issue management or code contributions .

 Thank you!

 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 The Site.module provides base content entities to represent sites and projects.

 Initially designed to monitor Drupal site state, there are many different use cases.

 
 
 
 
 
 Site State Tracking 
 
 Store overall state of the site using Drupal core status report & Site Audit module checks. 
 Tracks properties such as Drupal version, PHP version, Install time, Cron Last, and more . 
 Site Entity Reports store config changes, showing before and after. 
 
 
 
 Site & Project Content Entities 
 
 Site Entities are revisionable, tracking changes over time. 
 Site Entities are fieldable. Store any additional information for display in the site and any connected Site Managers. 
 Project entities represent your Drupal site across environments, and can be used to group generic websites together. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Remote Data 
 
 Send site entity data to any remote endpoint. 
 Connect to a Site Manager instance to synchronize entity data and provide actions like Remote Login. 
 Gather reports from all environments of a project in one place, creating a CI Dashboard. 
 Set up your own Site Manager, or try Sites.Watch . 
 
 
 
 Site Properties 
 
 HTTP Status 
 Git Remote 
 Git Reference 
 Drupal Site UUID 
 Host Provider 
 PHP Version 
 Drupal Version 
 Last Cron Run 
 Site Install Time 
 and more...
